title: DockRIFT 1.0.0: Receptor-conditioned docking rank stability and Rank Resolution Limit analysis
description: DockRIFT is an open-source Python toolkit and local-first visual workbench for separating within-receptor stochastic repeatability from receptor-to-receptor rank transferability in molecular docking. It implements rank correlation, exact pairwise inversion, rank displacement, Top-k stability, receptor-versus-seed attribution, and an observed-support Rank Resolution Limit with directional analysis and explicit censoring. The release includes CLI and Studio interfaces, tests, demo data, documentation, and reproducibility/provenance exports.
